business_problem: Agnostic Intelligence, a Swiss start-up, developed an AI-based platform to tackle supply chain risks. Using advanced algorithms and machine learning, it provides real-time insights and proactive risk management, addressing cyber-attacks, compliance, and legal risks.
solution_summary: Agnostic Intelligence built this solution on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Services, Azure App Service, Azure SQL Database. Agnostic Intelligence, a Swiss start-up, developed an AI-based platform to tackle supply chain risks. Azure OpenAI Service provides the generative AI model layer used for summarization, drafting, classification, or copilots in the workflow. Azure AI Services applies managed AI models to analyze content and automate business decisions. Azure App Service hosts the web application and API endpoints for the solution. Azure SQL Database stores transactional and reporting data that the application depends on.

business_outcome: With Microsoft's support, Agnostic Intelligence will continue to develop and improve its analytical tools.
